concept.title: WICKWOOD
concept.subtitle: Five Nights in Wickwood
concept.premise: Survivors keep a campfire lit for five nights while Wick, a 14-foot candle-wax stag that hunts light rather than people, walks the forest snuffing every light source it can reach.
